conservative.requirements: 10 power. You must have at least 2 other Order spells recharging. Effect: Your various insights into the future coalesce into a sudden realization of truth. You may take a number of recharge tokens, as indicated below, from your recharging Celestial Order cards and place them on this card. Do, then place a like number of recharge tokens on one non-basic action card belonging to the target. (That card does not have to be recharging) {Dc} 5
conservative.name: All That I Have Foreseen
